ينمحص (form VII)
# يَنْمَحِصُ (yanmaḥiṣu) /jan.ma.ħi.sˤu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْمَحَصَ (inmaḥaṣa)
# يَنْمَحِصَ (yanmaḥiṣa) /jan.ma.ħi.sˤa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْمَحَصَ (inmaḥaṣa)
# يَنْمَحِصْ (yanmaḥiṣ) /jan.ma.ħisˤ/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْمَحَصَ (inmaḥaṣa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
